name: expandable-card

frames.best_why: Expanded modal card with the cover photo, title, green Play CTA and detail copy all visible.

tagline: List rows morph into a full card with cover art and copy.
summary: A compact list of titled items with thumbnails and a Play button. Clicking a row animates it into a large centred card with a big cover image, a green call to action and scrollable detail text, over a blurred backdrop.
appearance: A short dark list of four rows, each with a small square thumbnail, a title and a grey name line, and a rounded Play pill at the far right. Clicking one grows it into a centred dark card with a tall cover photo, a bold title and subtitle, a green Play pill and a block of small grey copy.
behaviour: Clicking a row morphs it in place into the modal card while the other rows blur behind a dark overlay, the thumbnail growing into the cover image. Hovering a row highlights it and turns its Play pill green; Escape, an outside click or the close button returns to the list.
demo_content: Songs: Northern Lights by Maya Lindqvist, Paper Satellites by The Slow Hours, Concrete Garden, Low Tide.
search_phrases: list that expands into a card
click row to open detail card
gallery item that grows into a modal
smooth transition from row to panel
use_when: A compact list of media or products should reveal a richer image-and-copy card without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The morph needs a tall viewport and locks page scroll; long detail text is clipped into a short scroll area.
customise: Cards come as an array of title, description, image src, CTA text and link, plus a content node; a variant switches between compact list and two-column grid.
weight_why: Four list rows and four images with one shared-layout animation on open.

a11y.note: Rows are clickable divs that cannot be focused, so keyboard users cannot open a card; the modal has no dialog role and no reduced-motion handling.

issues: Rows are clickable divs with no keyboard focus, so the card cannot be opened without a mouse.
The expanded card's detail text is clipped into a short scroll area under a fade.
polish_why: Smooth shared-layout morph and a clean card; keyboard access and the scroll fade are weak.
